title: Quantum parallel repetition
abstract: Proves a quantitative parallel-repetition theorem for finite two-player quantum games: whenever the entangled value is below one, the entangled values of parallel repetitions decay exponentially, with an explicit universal exponent in the game gap and answer-alphabet sizes.

informal.QuantumParallelRepetition.distributionUn: There is a universal positive constant giving an explicit exponential upper bound on the repeated entangled value of every finite game with positive gap and nonempty answer alphabets.
informal.QuantumParallelRepetition.standardQuantu: Every finite two-player game whose entangled value is below one has exponentially decaying entangled value under parallel repetition.
